breaking_news.headline: Former '60 Minutes' correspondent Scott Pelley speaks out after firing
breaking_news.summary: Former 60 Minutes correspondent Scott Pelley said CBS news leader Bari Weiss shouldn't be leading the network. Pelley spoke to The New York Times just days after being fired by CBS.

breaking_news.headline: NPR's new chief content officer: 'I've been training for this job my whole life'
breaking_news.summary: Less than two weeks after overhauling its newsroom, NPR has hired Nadine Zylstra to be its chief content officer. She has been a top executive at Sesame Workshop, YouTube and Pinterest.

breaking_news.headline: With just days left, the U.S. opening match at the World Cup is still not sold out
breaking_news.summary: Hundreds of tickets are still available for the U.S. and Canada opening matches for the World Cup on Friday. Even more are available in resale platforms — many at below face value.

breaking_news.headline: Hey, Siri: Apple just announced a long-awaited AI update
breaking_news.summary: At its annual developers' conference, Apple put the spotlight on new AI features, while highlighting security and child safety — and critiquing the company's AI competitors.

breaking_news.headline: Social Security funds could run short by 2032, program's Trustees warn
breaking_news.summary: A trust fund that helps to finance Social Security benefits is expected to run out of money in less than seven years — unless Congress acts to patch the system before that.

breaking_news.headline: House approves bill to speed up union contract negotiations
breaking_news.summary: The House has approved a bill to slash the time it takes for newly unionized workers to get a first contract. The measure allows for government intervention if a deal is not reached within 90 days.

breaking_news.headline: Inflation tops 4% for the first time in 3 years on spike in gasoline prices
breaking_news.summary: Inflation has surged to its highest level in more than three years since the U.S. and Israel launched their war on Iran, triggering a surge in gasoline prices.

breaking_news.headline: FBI seizing evidence at California plant where chemical tank overheated
breaking_news.summary: Federal authorities served a search warrant on Wednesday at a Southern California aerospace facility where a chemical tank overheated last month, forcing 50,000 residents to evacuate because authorities feared an explosion.

breaking_news.headline: French singer Patrick Bruel faces rape charges
breaking_news.summary: Bruel has been placed under judicial investigation, which means an examining magistrate will look more deeply into the case.

breaking_news.headline: US official claims banned referee had links with 'terror organisations'
breaking_news.summary: Somali referee Omar Artan was denied entry to the United States because of his "association with suspected members of terror organisations," says a US official.

breaking_news.headline: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon kill 17, reports say
breaking_news.summary: Nine of them were killed in a series of attacks in the town of Tayr Debba, according to Lebanon's state news agency.

breaking_news.headline: Bill Gates says Epstein wanted personal relationship, but he 'never reciprocated'
breaking_news.summary: The Microsoft co-founder spent hours talking to lawmakers behind closed doors, where he also said Epstein used his marital infidelities to pressure him.

breaking_news.headline: Whale graveyard dating back five million years discovered
breaking_news.summary: The Indian Ocean site is "far beyond anything we had imagined", one researcher says.

breaking_news.headline: Fireworks illuminate Barcelona's Sagrada Família during Pope visit
breaking_news.summary: Pope Leo XIV says Barcelona's iconic Sagrada Família is a masterpiece of "stones, colours and light" during his visit to Spain.

breaking_news.headline: Three Indian sailors missing after US says it hit tanker in Gulf of Oman
breaking_news.summary: India's government said three Indian sailors were missing and 21 crew had been rescued after the hit on the Settebello off the coast of Oman.

breaking_news.headline: Trump says US will hit Iran 'hard' again today
breaking_news.summary: The US president warns Iran "will have to pay the price" for taking too long to agree a deal, after Tehran vows retaliation to any attacks.

breaking_news.headline: Illegal mini-marts to shut for up to 12 months under law change prompted by BBC
breaking_news.summary: Under current rules, shops breaking the law can only be closed for up to six months in England and Wales.

breaking_news.headline: Bill debt soars but many don't know help is available
breaking_news.summary: The majority of billpayers are unaware of special tariffs for water and broadband, the spending watchdog says.

breaking_news.headline: 'A little goes a long way': New York's candy stores sweeten economic gloom
breaking_news.summary: While US consumer confidence is at an historic low the Big Apple's sweet shops are expanding.

breaking_news.headline: World Cup expected to be the biggest betting event in history
breaking_news.summary: The expansion of the number of games being played is set to drive a surge in the amount of bets placed on this year's World Cup.
